|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Kitik Keed'kak (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “You may add X to attrition in battles at same site, where X = total number of opponent's characters present. May not be aboard starships or enclosed vehicles.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “During battle, may add 1 to your attrition against opponent for each opponent’s character present. May not deploy to or board starfighters or enclosed vehicles.” '''What changed:''' “You” → “During battle,”; “X” → “1”; added “your”; “in battles at same site, where X = total number of opponent's characters” → “against opponent for each opponent’s character”; “be aboard starships” → “deploy to or board starfighters”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards2.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 39. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Kitik Keed'kak]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour#Cards|Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Kitik Keed'kak (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Kitik Keed'kak]]. Code OVS2 · GEMP id 1102_39.
